teacher_info.teaching_style: My teaching style is one where I just help and guide the students to the right path rather than having them repeat after me like a parrot. If I do give homework it will be something they can learn and use in their every day life, for example I will tell them to choose a dish they like making and then to write a recipe in English or Afrikaans so that they can tell me how to make it. MY TRIAL LESSONS ARE FOR YOU.

Tell me about yourself and why you want to improve English so that I can shape my lessons to your needs so that you can benefit the most during our time together.

What are you waiting for? Let's go!

pro_course_detail.title: Structured English Lessons (Beginner to Advanced)
pro_course_detail.description:
What are structured English lessons?

Do you remember when you were learning English in school? Learning grammar, reading and doing exercises from a textbook. This class is kind of like that, but less boring. How less boring you might ask? Less boring because in school, you learned all these things but you didn't get enough practice which is why in this class, we will practice our speaking as much as possible while working through a textbook.

Who is this lesson for?

This lesson is for people who are looking for a structured lesson because they want to cover topics that they have missed or haven’t learn about yet but also still want to focus on improving their speaking. 

What will we be learning in this lesson?

Depending on your level of (Beginner to Advanced), your lesson will be planned around the content of a textbook that is suitable for your level.   In every chapter, we will cover (in this order):

Vocabulary
Grammar
Pronunciation
Reading
Listening 
Speaking

pro_course_detail.title: Business English Conversations
pro_course_detail.description:
This Business English lesson is designed to help you develop industry-specific vocabulary and enhance your ability to communicate effectively in professional settings. 

We'll be using a General Business English textbook to guide our lessons, ensuring you build a strong foundation for workplace communication.

A bit about me: I have a degree in International Trade and Logistics, and having recently graduated, I’m eager to gain practical experience in this field.

Note: I only offer lessons to adults.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversations
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking for engaging conversations to help you improve your English?

Look no further—I’m just the guy! With my endless curiosity and a knack for asking thought-provoking questions, you’ll find yourself learning English naturally in no time. 

Here’s how my lessons work:

In each session, we dive into discussions on a wide variety of topics, from famous personalities to the future of the world, it really depends on what you like talking about. 

These conversations are designed to improve your fluency, build confidence, and expand your vocabulary.

To support your progress, I may assign grammar homework between sessions, focusing on areas where you need the most practice. This way, we can make sure you’re constantly improving.

Feel free to ask if you have any questions about how the lessons work or if you have specific language goals you’d like to focus on. I’m here to help you improve your English and achieve your speaking goals.

Please note: I only offer lessons to adult learners.

Let’s start chat friend!
